newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was active midmorning for about an hour, otherwise very slow late Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed $0.50 lower than last Friday or $1.00 lower than last week's bulk of sales.

Inquiry was good, demand was light. Sales confirmed on 24,700 slaughter steers and 21,400 slaughter heifers. Week to date 74,100 head confirmed including 23,500 head or about 32 percent or previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1050-1250 lbs 64.00, pen 64.50; Select with end of choice 62.00-63.50; load select and choice 1200 lb Holsteins 58.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1020-1200 lbs 64.00, few 64.50; few select with end choice 960-1075 lbs 63.00-63.50.
week to date: 74100 last week: 19800 last year: 11200
